prose: Basis: Reuters blocks automated fetching (HTTP 403), so this note rests on Techmeme's account. China's Star 50 index of AI and chip leaders is down 40% in under four months, erasing roughly $480 billion in market value; chipmaker CXMT alone is down about 25% in the past month. While global tech stocks teeter on AI-bubble worries, Reuters frames China's version as a crash already in progress, with lofty valuations collapsing under doubts about AI demand.
highlights: China's Star 50 AI-and-chip index is down 40% in under four months
About $480B in market value erased; CXMT is down ~25% in a month
Reuters frames it as the AI bubble already bursting in China while global stocks merely teeter
Reuters blocks fetching; note based on Techmeme's summary
